positions.title: Senior Graphics Software Engineer
positions.description:
I work on the Intel 3D drivers and the shader compiler in Mesa.

• Mesa project core contributor, top 10 in all time commits; top 10 in all time patch reviews
• Optimizing compiler specialist, increased performance greatly by improving Intel shader compiler
• Rearchitected parts of Intel shader compiler for significantly faster compilation
• Implemented a variety of new OpenGL features and extensions
• Enabled support for new graphics hardware generations

positions.title: Graphics Software Developer
positions.description: Profiled and identified deficiencies in the graphics stack on the XO 1.75 laptop. Optimized pixman using iwMMXt vector instructions, achieving 100%+ performance improvements.
positions.insights: ARM Architecture, ARM Assembly and +3 skills

volunteerExperiences.description:
I lead the Release Engineering team, whose responsibilities are building Gentoo's installation media and maintaining the infrastructure and tools used to do so. I also ported the distribution to MIPS' N32 and N64 ABIs and built installation media.

I've been elected to four terms on the Gentoo Council, the governing body that makes technical decisions for the distribution.

I maintain the Mesa and X11 packages, the GNOME desktop, and support odd architectures (Alpha and MIPS among others).
